sys_di_key.description:
Extract the Accounts Payable or Sundry Creditors balance as at the balance sheet date.
This field may appear under any of these labels: - Sundry Creditors, Trade Creditors, Creditors - Accounts Payable, Trade Payables - Bills Payable - Expenses Payable (include if it relates to trade/operational payables like sand, materials) - Salary & Wages Payable (EXCLUDE — this is employee liability, not trade payable) - ESIC Payable, Professional Tax Payable (EXCLUDE — statutory, not trade)
Rules: - Include ONLY trade/vendor payables (material suppliers, contractors) - EXCLUDE: statutory dues (GST, TDS, PT), salary payables, loan liabilities - This appears on the LIABILITIES side of the Balance Sheet under Current Liabilities - Return plain number only. If not found, return: NA
sys_di_key.name: Accounts Payable
